activity_statements.statement: operates the largest employee-owned grocery chain in the US with stores in Florida, Georgia, Alabama, South Carolina, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia and Kentucky
operates in-store pharmacies providing prescription dispensing, vaccine administration, specialty medications, compound medications and pet medications to customers
prepares custom deli selections, made-to-order subs, bakery items and themed cakes in each store location for in-store pickup and delivery via Instacart
delivers online grocery ordering with in-store pickup and third-party delivery integration for consumers in its operating markets
provides employer pharmacy solutions to corporate clients focusing on health and cost efficiency of employee populations

name_reality_gap: Labeled simply as Retail; Publix is actually a vertically integrated grocery and pharmacy operator with a distinctive employee-ownership structure — roughly 20% of staffing is pharmacy-focused, which a pure retail label misses.
extraction_notes: About-publix page returned mostly a privacy policy; company details drawn from pharmacy page and homepage which were concrete. Store count and geographic footprint confirmed from multiple sources.
